title: 第9章 再次提升第10章 四大族长聚
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
李北玄朝他点了点头，“你知道便好，我们现在并不宜与他们撕破脸！
天行，你要记住了，平和的时间拖得越久，对我们李家便越有利！”
按照这个趋势下去，要是再给他一年半载时间，他至少也能够恢复先天圆满境界！
到那时候，自己对上四大家族，也不是没有一战之力！
“爹，我知道了，我让族人尽量低调些，尽量不与四大家族之人发生冲突！”李天行点了点头。
听到李天行的安排，李北玄满意地对其点点头。
“对了，族人修行的资源也要安排妥当了，现在我李家已经步入正轨，资源应该能够满足日常修炼了吧！”
现在李家局面已经稳定下来，那么重点便是要在族人的修炼上了。
“天行，要多鼓励族人，让他们好好修炼，莫要辜负了家族对他们的培养！
现在是我李家的关键时期，他们的修为高出一分，到决战之时，我们李家的把握便能强上一分！”
李北玄看向李天行认真说道。
“爹，我知道了！”李天行重重地点了点头。
有了足够的修炼资源支持，这一个多月时间，族中的变化他是看在了眼里。
短短一个月，便有好几个族人突破了境界，可以说，现在他们李家的形势一片大好。
要是有个几年的时间发展，四大家族安敢再欺压他们李家！
李北玄对李天行挥手示意，“好了，没事那便回去处理族中的事务去吧！
还有便是莫要忘了修炼，虽然你现在突破几率不大，但也要坚持下去！”
最后也不忘嘱咐一句！
“爹，你放心便是，天行会将家族事务处理好的，更不会将修炼落下！”
说完，李天行便转头离去。

李北玄看着自己这个已经离去的便宜儿子，心中非常对其的沉稳非常满意。
正是有他打理族中事务，才使得现在他们李家井井有条，稳步发展！
李北玄之所以最后嘱咐他一句好好修炼，是因为他已经发现经过修炼之后，李天行的突破几率有了些提升。
信息面板之前显示的是有45%几率突破先天中期，现在变成了有55%几率突破！
照这般情况来看，他还是有很大几率突破到先天中期的！
“唉，可惜没有足够的灵药，不然也能帮助天行突破境界！”李北玄轻轻摇头叹息一声。
对于小女儿李天心也是一样，目前突破境界的几率也不大！
但李北玄却是坚持让她在湖心岛潜心修炼！
先天境界突破，想来应该能够提供不少的修为点吧！
思索了片刻之后，李北便没再去想了，他继续将鱼竿甩出去，鱼钩顺着鱼线应声入了湖中！
……
时间一天天的流逝，李家在李天行的打理之下，也在稳中向前。
反观四大家族，由于李北玄自始至终也都没有露过面，使得他们非常疑惑。
虽然如此，但他们也并没有选择对李家出手！
只是在暗地里想方设法打探李家老祖的虚实，但也没有得到准确的消息。
就这样，北源河畔表面平静，但在暗地里却是暗流涌动。
content_en:
Li Beixuan nodded towards him, "As long as you know, it's not appropriate for us to break up with them now!
Tianxing, you have to remember, the longer the peace lasts, the better it will be for our Li family! "
If this trend continues, if he is given another year and a half, he will at least be able to return to the realm of innate perfection!
By then, he will not be without the power to fight against the four major families!
"Dad, I understand. I asked the clan members to keep a low profile as much as possible and try not to conflict with people from the four major families!" Li Tianxing nodded.
After hearing Li Tianxing's arrangement, Li Beixuan nodded with satisfaction.
"By the way, the resources for people's cultivation must also be arranged properly. Now that my Li family is on the right track, the resources should be able to meet daily cultivation!"
Now that the situation of the Li family has stabilized, the focus is on the cultivation of the clan members.
“Tian Xing, encourage your clan members more and let them practice well, and don’t let down the family’s training for them!
Now is a critical period for our Li family. If their cultivation is higher, our Li family will be even more confident in the decisive battle! "
Li Beixuan looked at Li Tianxing and said seriously.
"Dad, I understand!" Li Tianxing nodded heavily.
With enough training resources to support him, he could see the changes in the clan in more than a month.
In just one month, several clan members have broken through the realm. It can be said that the situation of their Li family is very good now.
If it takes a few years to develop, how dare the four major families bully the Li family again!
Li Beixuan waved to Li Tianxing, "Okay, if you have nothing to do, go back and handle the affairs of the clan!
Also, don’t forget to practice. Although you have little chance of a breakthrough now, you must persevere! "
Don’t forget to give me a final word of advice!
"Dad, don't worry, Tianxing will take care of the family affairs, and he won't leave his cultivation behind!"
After saying that, Li Tianxing turned around and left.
Li Beixuan looked at his cheap son who had left, and was very satisfied with his calmness.
It is precisely because of him taking care of the affairs of the clan that the Li family is now in order and developing steadily!
The reason why Li Beixuan finally told him to practice hard was because he had discovered that after practicing, Li Tianxing's chance of breakthrough had improved somewhat.
The information panel previously showed that there was a 45% chance of breaking through the innate mid-term, but now it has become a 55% chance of breaking through!
Judging from this situation, he still has a high chance of breaking through to the middle stage of Xiantian!
"Alas, it's a pity that there are not enough elixirs, otherwise it would have helped Tianxing break through the realm!" Li Beixuan shook his head slightly and sighed.
The same is true for the youngest daughter Li Tianxin. The chance of breaking through the realm is not high at present!
But Li Beixuan insisted that she concentrate on practicing on the island in the middle of the lake!
A breakthrough in the innate realm should probably provide a lot of cultivation points!
After thinking for a moment, Li Bei stopped thinking about it. He continued to throw the fishing rod out, and the fishhook followed the fishing line and entered the lake!
…
Time passes day by day, and the Li family is moving forward steadily under the care of Li Tianxing.
On the other hand, the four major families were very confused because Li Beixuan had never shown his face from beginning to end.
Even so, they did not choose to take action against the Li family!
I just secretly tried to find out the truth about the ancestor of the Li family, but I didn't get accurate information.
In this way, the Beiyuan River is calm on the surface, but secretly there is an undercurrent surging.
